name: Crusader's Edge
summary: Give a melee weapon bane against evil outsiders.
description: The touched weapon gains bane against evil outsiders. A confirmed critical hit against a creature with the outsider type and evil subtype deals its normal critical damage and nauseates that creature for 1d3 rounds. A successful Fortitude save reduces the condition to sickened for one round.
components: M (dried blood from an evil outsider, sprinkled on the weapon)
